title: Becoming a Clinical Psychologist: My Story - Dr Marianne Trent

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.

sentences.en: We often spoke via Facebook and his wit and professionalism were so admired by me and others within our network.
sentences.zh: 我们经常通过Facebook交谈，他的智慧和专业精神深受我和我们网络中其他人的钦佩。

sentences.en: He was passionate about supporting children, young people and their families with their mental health needs.

sentences.en: At the time of his unexpected death from vaccine-induced thrombosis with thrombocytopenia
sentences.zh: 在他因疫苗诱导的血栓伴血小板减少症意外去世时，

sentences.en: in January 2021, he was days away from starting a new role with Great Ormond Street Hospital

sentences.en: Chapter 26.
sentences.zh: 第26章。

sentences.en: Marianne's story.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安的故事。

sentences.en: Owning our story.
sentences.zh: 拥有我们的故事。

sentences.en: I honestly think I have the best job in the world and sometimes I have to pinch myself to reflect upon the fact that I get paid for doing stuff which makes me really happy.
sentences.zh: 我真心认为我拥有世界上最好的工作，有时我不得不掐自己一下，反思我竟然能因为做让我真正快乐的事情而获得报酬。

sentences.en: When I was studying my undergrad course at Glamorgan University I actually found the module on clinical psychology pretty boring.
sentences.zh: 当我在格拉摩根大学（Glamorgan University）读本科时，我其实觉得临床心理学模块相当无聊。

sentences.en: It seemed to only be about data and neuropsych testing and with only theory and textbooks to look at it all felt a bit dry.
sentences.zh: 它似乎只关乎数据和神经心理学测试，只有理论和教科书可看，一切都显得有点枯燥。

sentences.en: I love learning from experience and learning about people and hearing them speak.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢从经验中学习，了解人，听他们说话。

sentences.en: For me it just didn't appeal.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，它根本没有吸引力。

sentences.en: I don't even really recall having heard of the job title clinical psychologist until the week before my undergrad finals.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不记得在本科期末考试前一周之前听说过“临床心理学家”这个职位名称。

sentences.en: We all traipsed into the lecture theatre for a chat on different career options post-graduation.
sentences.zh: 我们都拖着步子走进阶梯教室，讨论毕业后的不同职业选择。

sentences.en: One of the lecturers mentioned what a clinical psychologist did and how it was super hard to get into training.
sentences.zh: 其中一位讲师提到了临床心理学家是做什么的，以及进入培训是多么困难。

sentences.en: She said we probably shouldn't bother and should do something else instead.
sentences.zh: 她说我们可能不应该费心，应该去做点别的。

sentences.en: Well that was enough for me.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这对我来说就足够了。

sentences.en: From that point forwards that's the career I wanted.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，这就是我想要的职业。

sentences.en: The thing is I know that I'm not alone in that either.
sentences.zh: 问题是，我知道我在这方面并不孤单。

sentences.en: I'm in a psychologist Facebook group of over 3,000 people and in a recent post surveying why people got
sentences.zh: 我在一个拥有超过3000人的心理学家Facebook群组中，在最近一篇调查人们为何进入

sentences.en: into the profession a staggeringly high number of us said that part of our motivation for becoming a clinical psychologist was because we had been told just how difficult it was.
sentences.zh: 该行业的帖子中，我们中有惊人比例的人表示，我们成为临床心理学家的部分动力是因为我们被告知这有多么困难。

sentences.en: Seriously what does that say about our dogged determination, our desire to prove ourselves, maybe even our masochism, perfectionism and ego?
sentences.zh: 说真的，这说明了我们什么样的顽强决心、证明自己的渴望，甚至可能是我们的受虐倾向、完美主义和自我意识？

sentences.en: Well, there's a doctoral thesis topic for you if you ever needed one.
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你需要的话，这倒是一个博士论文的主题。

sentences.en: I think it's interesting that at the time I see there were 3,000 people in that Facebook group
sentences.zh: 我觉得有趣的是，当时我看到那个Facebook群组里有3000人，

sentences.en: and I've just had a little look now and it's 6,500 and it's a group for psychologists in private practice.
sentences.zh: 我刚才看了一下，现在有6500人了，这是一个针对私人执业心理学家的群组。

sentences.en: And it seems that since 2021, there's been quite the explosion of people either starting their private practice or certainly surveying their options.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来自2021年以来，开始私人执业或至少在考察选择的人数出现了爆炸式增长。

sentences.en: Let's get back to
sentences.zh: 让我们回到

sentences.en: 2021, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 2021年，玛丽安。

sentences.en: Speaking of ego, I gained my first AP post, that means assistant psychologist, by the way, at St Andrew's Healthcare.
sentences.zh: 说到自我，我是在圣安德鲁医疗保健中心（St Andrew's Healthcare）获得了我的第一个AP职位，顺便说一下，那意味着助理心理学家。

sentences.en: And they had the coolest name badges.
sentences.zh: 他们有最酷的姓名牌。

sentences.en: They were gold enamel and they said my name and job title Marianne Durran assistant psychologist honestly wearing
sentences.zh: 它们是金色的珐琅，上面写着我的名字和职位：玛丽安·杜兰（Marianne Durran），助理心理学家。老实说，第一次戴上

sentences.en: that little beauty for the first time and checking myself out in the mirrored walls on one of the
sentences.zh: 那个小宝贝，在其中一个病房的镜墙上打量自己，穿着我为了搭配金色徽章而买的

sentences.en: wards in the cool new assistant psychologist clothes I had bought to complement the gold badge
sentences.zh: 酷炫的新助理心理学家服装，

sentences.en: remains one of my proudest psychology moments to date I wish I still had that badge I wonder where it is.
sentences.zh: 至今仍是我最自豪的心理学时刻之一。我真希望我还留着那个徽章，不知道它在哪儿。

sentences.en: I think they made me give it back when I left.
sentences.zh: 我想我离开时他们让我把它还回去了。

sentences.en: Maybe I should make myself a gold badge now.
sentences.zh: 也许我现在应该给自己做一个金色徽章。

sentences.en: Probably wouldn't look nearly as snazzy, teamed with my working from home pyjama bottoms though.
sentences.zh: 不过搭配我居家办公的睡裤，可能看起来一点也不时髦。

sentences.en: The thing is, I think I'm probably much less of an arse now I'm qualified than I was when I was an assistant.
sentences.zh: 问题是，我觉得我获得资格后比当助理时要少很多混蛋气。

sentences.en: One of my pet hates is when people refer to themselves as psychologists when actually they've only done an undergrad.
sentences.zh: 我最讨厌的一件事就是人们在只读了本科的情况下就自称是心理学家。

sentences.en: I wish psychologist was a proper protected title so that everyone knew they were in safe hands.
sentences.zh: 我希望“心理学家”是一个受到妥善保护的头衔，这样每个人都知道他们在安全的手中。

sentences.en: Confession time.
sentences.zh: 坦白时间。

sentences.en: I wonder whether it irks me so much because actually that used to be me.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否让我如此恼火，是因为那曾经就是我。

sentences.en: I loved chatting to people and telling them that I was a psychologist when actually I was an assistant psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢和人聊天，告诉他们我是心理学家，而实际上我只是个助理心理学家。

sentences.en: These days I'm proud to be a psychologist but I don't tend to tell anyone who will listen that I am one.
sentences.zh: 如今，我为自己是一名心理学家而自豪，但我不会倾向于告诉每一个愿意听的人我是心理学家。

sentences.en: I think there's something to be said about the imposter curve.
sentences.zh: 我认为关于“冒充者曲线”（imposter curve）有一些值得探讨的地方。

sentences.en: The less we know the more naive we are to this and as we get more experienced we become more aware of everything we don't know and we are more likely to stay within our limits.
sentences.zh: 我们知道得越少，就越天真，而随着我们经验的增加，我们对所有自己不知道的事情就越了解，也更有可能保持在自己的能力范围内。

sentences.en: So in 2007 whilst I was completing my form it's fair to say that I wasn't having the best time of life.
sentences.zh: 所以，在2007年我填写申请表时，不得不说我当时的生活并不好过。

sentences.en: My friend Cara refers to this stage in life as that where I mainly ate carrots and hummus.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友卡拉（Cara）把人生的这个阶段称为“我主要吃胡萝卜和鹰嘴豆泥”的时期。

sentences.en: At the start of August I decided to separate from a long-term partner which had not been easy.
sentences.zh: 8月初，我决定与一位长期伴侣分手，这并不容易。

sentences.en: A few weeks later whilst on my way to my first ever boot camp class and then there's a little footnote.
sentences.zh: 几周后，在去参加我人生中第一次训练营课程的路上，这里有个小脚注。

sentences.en: I never did make it to the boot camp class and never been to one since either.
sentences.zh: 我最终没能去成那个训练营课程，之后也从未去过。

sentences.en: It wasn't meant to be I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想这是命中注定的。

sentences.en: Although as an aside I have now been to several boot camp style classes.
sentences.zh: 虽然顺便提一下，我现在已经参加过好几次训练营风格的课程了。

sentences.en: So this is the growth that can occur for you in four years.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你在四年里可以获得的成长。

sentences.en: So let's go back to before the little footnote so that this makes sense.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到小脚注之前，这样逻辑才通顺。

sentences.en: A few weeks later, whilst on my way to my first ever boot camp class, a chap in a Jaguar crashed into me in my beautiful Yaris.
sentences.zh: 几周后，在去参加我人生中第一次训练营课程的路上，一个开捷豹的家伙撞上了我那辆漂亮的雅力士（Yaris）。

sentences.en: My car was written off.
sentences.zh: 我的车报废了。

sentences.en: I got whiplash in my neck and back and almost immediately after I started studying for my masters with Newman University College.
sentences.zh: 我的脖子和背部受了鞭打伤，几乎就在那之后，我开始在纽曼大学学院（Newman University College）攻读硕士学位。

sentences.en: They're now just called Newman University.
sentences.zh: 他们现在只叫纽曼大学。

sentences.en: This was all whilst working full-time and being in pain whilst striving for my first ever NHS assistant poSt. I was applying for jobs all over the country.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是在我全职工作、忍受疼痛的同时，为了争取我人生中第一个NHS助理职位而进行的。我当时在全国各地申请工作。

sentences.en: I recall at one stage crying on the stairs at home the day before an assistant interview in Nottingham.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次在诺丁汉参加助理面试的前一天，我在家里的楼梯上哭泣。

sentences.en: I was in pain.
sentences.zh: 我很痛苦。

sentences.en: It was in the days before I owned a sat nav and I wasn't even sure it was a job I wanted anyway but I really wanted it for the form.
sentences.zh: 那是在我还没有卫星导航的日子里，我甚至不确定那是不是我想要的工作，但我真的为了申请表想要它。

sentences.en: My mum, clearly a bit shocked, actually did pull it out the bag and say, if it's too much then just cancel the interview, don't go.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈显然有点震惊，她真的挺身而出说，如果太累了，就取消面试，别去了。

sentences.en: So that's what I did and instead spent my day off doing a bit of R&R and likely for me at the time probably listening to a bit of R&B.
sentences.zh: 所以我就是这么做的，反而把休息日花在休息和放松上，当时对我来说可能是在听一点R&B音乐。

sentences.zh: 所以请记住这一点。

sentences.en: The unit loved having me too because assistant psychologists are such a fantastic resource and they'd never had one before.
sentences.zh: 那个部门也很喜欢我，因为助理心理学家是非常棒的资源，而且他们以前从未有过助理。

sentences.en: I seem to recall after I left they did go on to then employ one too.
sentences.zh: 我记得我离开后，他们确实接着雇了一位。

sentences.en: So it paves the way and shows just how useful and essential assistants are.
sentences.zh: 所以这铺平了道路，也证明了助理是多么有用和不可或缺。

sentences.en: I finished this post in the summer and by October I was starting my first paid assistant poSt. There is
sentences.zh: 我在夏天结束了这份工作，到十月我就开始了第一份带薪助理工作。还有

sentences.en: another video you can watch or listen to about the ethics of honorary assistant psychologist posts so please do check that out if you get a chance.
sentences.zh: 另一个视频你可以观看或收听，关于荣誉助理心理学家职位的道德问题，如果有机会请务必去看看。

sentences.en: CV gap plugging the creative way number two.
sentences.zh: 填补简历空白的创意方法之二。

sentences.en: By the time I was six years post undergrad, I had experience working with physically disabled adults, working age adults, older adults and forensic clients.
sentences.zh: 到我本科毕业六年时，我已经有了与残疾成人、工作年龄成人、老年人和法医客户工作的经验。

sentences.en: I'd also had a wicked time traveling around the world for eight months and temping in offices and doing home caring to fund it.
sentences.zh: 我还度过了一段疯狂的时光，环游世界八个月，在办公室做临时工，并通过居家护理来资助旅行。

sentences.en: Another little footnote, no time or space to discuss home caring here, but I loved that job.
sentences.zh: 另一个小注脚，这里没有时间和空间讨论居家护理，但我很喜欢那份工作。

sentences.en: Such a privilege and actually laughed a lot with my clients but also taught me a lot about
sentences.zh: 那是一种荣幸，实际上我和客户们笑得很开心，但也教会了我很多关于

sentences.en: dignity, respect and truSt. Also gave me lots of opportunities to wonder at 3am in the morning whether I'd remembered to lock my client's door.
sentences.zh: 尊严、尊重和信任的知识。它还给了我很多机会，让我会在凌晨三点怀疑自己是否记得锁好客户的门。

sentences.en: I had zero experience with children and young people.
sentences.zh: 我当时在儿童和青少年方面完全没有经验。

sentences.en: I reached out to a local Brownie group and there followed two years of the most incredible learning and fun experiences as honorary Wise Owl.
sentences.zh: 我联系了当地的一个布朗尼女童军小组，随后开始了为期两年的最不可思议的学习和有趣的经历，担任荣誉“智慧猫头鹰”。

sentences.en: It was so helpful to learn about the normal scope of children rather than just the clinical aspect I would later see.
sentences.zh: 了解儿童的正常成长范围，而不是仅仅关注我后来会看到的临床方面，这非常有帮助。

sentences.en: I could also totally fit one evening a week into my schedule too.
sentences.zh: 我每周还能完全抽出一个晚上来参加活动。

sentences.en: Being able to speak about these children in my secure training unit interview for young people totally bagged me my first NHS assistant post two, so it worked.
sentences.zh: 能够在我的青少年安全培训单位面试中谈论这些孩子，完全帮我拿下了第一份NHS助理职位，所以这招很管用。

sentences.en: CV gap plugging the creative way number three.
sentences.zh: 填补简历空白的创意方法之三。

sentences.en: Reach out to your local NHS trust and ask if there are any research meetings or groups or any key researchers you can be put in touch with.
sentences.zh: 联系你当地的NHS信托机构，询问是否有任何研究会议、小组，或者可以联系的关键研究人员。

sentences.en: I learned a lot of useful stuff for my thesis by going along to research meetings whilst I was training.
sentences.zh: 我在培训期间通过参加研究会议，学到了很多对我的论文有用的东西。

sentences.en: If you don't yet have research experience you could also find some honorary stuff which will look great on your CV too.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有研究经验，也可以找一些荣誉职位，这在你的简历上也会很好看。

sentences.en: When I was an assistant in exchange for being able to put honorary research assistant on my form I helped a trainee out with some of her bits and pieces for data collection too.
sentences.zh: 当我还是助理时，为了能在表格上写上“荣誉研究助理”，我也帮一位实习生处理了一些数据收集工作。

sentences.en: Create and count your publications.
sentences.zh: 创造并统计你的出版物。

sentences.en: When I was striving for training, no one in my department was free to present their research at an upcoming international conference in Nottingham.
sentences.zh: 当我努力争取培训机会时，我部门里没有人有空去诺丁汉参加即将举行的国际会议并展示他们的研究。

sentences.en: So I volunteered and they were delighted I had.
sentences.zh: 所以我自告奋勇，他们很高兴我这么做了。

sentences.en: And so I did it.
sentences.zh: 于是我就去了。

sentences.en: I put it on my form as it counts as a publication.
sentences.zh: 我把它写在表格上，因为它算作出版物。

sentences.en: I also wrote a vaguely amusing post-conference report and submitted it to a journal.
sentences.zh: 我还写了一篇稍微有点意思的会后报告，并提交给了一本期刊。

sentences.en: It was accepted and published, and you've guessed it, it counted as a publication.
sentences.zh: 它被接受并发表了，你猜对了，它算作出版物。

sentences.en: I also offered to write up the research for a journal because the qualified staff were struggling to find the time and then ended up as third author for the project.
sentences.zh: 我还主动提出为期刊撰写研究报告，因为有资质的员工很难抽出时间，最终我成为了该项目的第三作者。

sentences.en: Think about ways you can gain publication experience, which might involve thinking outside the box and asking for opportunities.
sentences.zh: 思考一下你可以获得出版经验的方法，这可能需要跳出思维定势，主动寻求机会。

sentences.en: Can you get involved with a book or research?
sentences.zh: 你能参与书籍或研究项目吗？

sentences.en: You do you.
sentences.zh: 做你自己。

sentences.en: Be you.
sentences.zh: 展现你自己。

sentences.en: You're great.
sentences.zh: 你很棒。

sentences.en: Reflect and make sure the form sounds like you and shows your unique skills, talents and interests.
sentences.zh: 反思并确保表格听起来像你，展示出你独特的技能、天赋和兴趣。

sentences.en: Consider using section subheadings so that your form makes sense and flows well.
sentences.zh: 考虑使用章节小标题，这样你的表格逻辑清晰，条理顺畅。

sentences.en: In forms I have reviewed, I often find that answering questions in massive full sentences is a waste of space.
sentences.zh: 在我审阅过的表格中，我经常发现用大段完整的句子回答问题是在浪费空间。

sentences.en: Be concise but easy to understand.
sentences.zh: 要简洁明了，易于理解。

sentences.en: Don't use fancy words which mean nothing.
sentences.zh: 不要使用毫无意义的花哨词汇。

sentences.en: Don't leave the relevant experience section blank.
sentences.zh: 不要把相关经验部分留空。

sentences.en: Fill the space on your form, but make sure it's easy to read.
sentences.zh: 填满表格的空间，但要确保易于阅读。

sentences.en: I also prefer to read in a present tense.
sentences.zh: 我也更喜欢阅读用现在时写的文字。

sentences.en: You've not lost the skills just because you're no longer doing that job.
sentences.zh: 你并没有因为不再从事那份工作就失去了那些技能。

sentences.en: These are some of the observations I made in a form I reviewed last year.
sentences.zh: 这些是我去年在审阅一份表格时做出的一些观察。

sentences.en: This is page six in the application and I currently feel I know nothing about you or what interests you or what makes you unique.
sentences.zh: 这是申请表的第六页，目前我觉得我对你一无所知，不知道你对什么感兴趣，也不知道是什么让你与众不同。

sentences.en: I feel this whole section falls a bit flat.
sentences.zh: 我觉得整个部分显得有些平淡。

sentences.en: And there's another one.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个例子。

sentences.en: Try not to just tick boxes for the sake of it.
sentences.zh: 尽量不要为了填表而填表。

sentences.en: Be interested and interesting.
sentences.zh: 要感兴趣，也要有趣。

sentences.en: It's often a good idea to get someone qualified to review your form.
sentences.zh: 找一个有资质的人来审阅你的表格通常是个好主意。

sentences.en: It's much better to get this feedback from someone before you submit your form, rather than it be thought by someone screening your form at your dream course.
sentences.zh: 在提交表格之前从别人那里获得反馈，远比被你梦想课程的筛选人员认为不行要好得多。

sentences.en: No one is coming to save you.
sentences.zh: 没有人会来拯救你。

sentences.en: Reach out to people.
sentences.zh: 主动去联系别人。

sentences.en: Create opportunities for yourself.
sentences.zh: 为你自己创造机会。

sentences.en: Chance it.
sentences.zh: 去尝试一下。

sentences.en: If you don't ask, you're much less likely to get.
sentences.zh: 如果你不问，你得到的机会就小得多。

sentences.en: You literally have nothing to lose and potentially everything to gain.
sentences.zh: 你真的没什么可失去的，却可能拥有一切。

sentences.en: Practice interviews.
sentences.zh: 练习面试。

sentences.en: I absolutely cringed at the time and definitely didn't want to do it, but in 2008 my NHS supervisor Charlotte did a mock interview for me ahead of my two clinical interviews.
sentences.zh: 我当时感到非常尴尬，绝对不想做，但在2008年，我的NHS主管Charlotte在我参加两次临床面试前为我进行了模拟面试。

sentences.en: It was fantastically helpful and got my rabbit in the headlights moments out of the way in a supportive and risk-free situation.
sentences.zh: 这非常有帮助，让我在一个支持性且无风险的环境中克服了“惊弓之鸟”的状态。

sentences.en: This is something I've done for a number of assistants too, and they all universally cringe, but all say it was helpful in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 这也是我为许多助理做过的事情，他们一开始都感到尴尬，但事后都说这很有帮助。

sentences.en: Speaking of cringing,
sentences.zh: 说到尴尬，

sentences.en: Charlotte was also present for my first ever therapy session with a young person.
sentences.zh: Charlotte也出席了我第一次与年轻人的治疗课程。

sentences.en: Honestly, it was dreadful, so awkward.
sentences.zh: 老实说，那太糟糕了，非常尴尬。

sentences.en: It was in a forensic unit, and the young person was far cooler than me.
sentences.zh: 那是在一个法医部门，那个年轻人比我酷多了。

sentences.en: To both Charlotte and the young person, thanks and sorry.
sentences.zh: 对于Charlotte和那位年轻人，谢谢你们，也抱歉。

sentences.en: I'm now much better at therapy, but couldn't have got there without either of you.
sentences.zh: 我现在治疗水平好多了，但没有你们任何一方，我都不可能走到今天。

sentences.en: Lastly, follow your dreaMs. The other day my eight-year-old son asked me a question.
sentences.zh: 最后，追随你的梦想。前几天，我八岁的儿子问了我一个问题。

sentences.en: Mummy, when you were younger, what did you want to be when you grew up?
sentences.zh: “妈妈，你年轻的时候，长大想做什么？”

sentences.en: A doctor and a journalist, I replied.
sentences.zh: “医生和记者，”我回答。

sentences.en: Oh, but that's not your job now.
sentences.zh: “哦，但那不是你现在的工作啊。”

sentences.en: You don't read the news.
sentences.zh: “你不读新闻。”

sentences.en: Well, no baby, but I was on it once and I love that I help people to feel better in person but also through my writing.
sentences.zh: “嗯，是的宝贝，但我曾经做过，而且我很高兴我不仅能亲自帮助别人，还能通过写作来帮助他们。”

sentences.en: I really hope that this book and maybe even my own story have been helpful for you.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望这本书，甚至是我自己的故事，对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: And then what's quite fun is there's emails and reflections that I gave to the authors who contributed stories.
sentences.zh: 还有一件很有趣的事，就是我给那些贡献了故事的作者们发了邮件和反思。

sentences.en: So I sent myself a future email.
sentences.zh: 所以我给自己发了一封未来的邮件。

sentences.en: Email to Dr Marianne
sentences.zh: 发给玛丽安博士的邮件

sentences.en: Trent on the 31st of August 2022.
sentences.zh: 特伦特，2022年8月31日。

sentences.en: Well hello future Marianne, currently you are literally hours away from clicking publish on your second book baby.
sentences.zh: 你好啊，未来的玛丽安，现在的你距离点击发布你的第二本“书宝宝”只剩下几个小时了。

sentences.en: It has been quite the project and one which has been wonderful to be part of.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个了不起的项目，能参与其中我感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: It's also been one which has seen your team grow to include an editorial assistant too.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个见证了你的团队壮大的项目，现在你们还增加了一位编辑助理。

sentences.en: Currently however you're wondering whether anyone will buy the new book, whether they'll find it helpful and hoping that the contributors all like the way it looks when it's done.
sentences.zh: 不过，现在的你可能还在担心是否有人会买这本新书，担心他们是否会觉得这本书有帮助，同时也希望所有的撰稿人都能喜欢它最终呈现出来的样子。

sentences.en: So how has the last year been for you Marianne of 2022?
sentences.zh: 那么，2022年的玛丽安，过去这一年你过得怎么样？

sentences.en: Have you been able to achieve the goals you set yourself?
sentences.zh: 你实现自己设定的目标了吗？

sentences.en: Did the other book you've already made a start on get published?
sentences.zh: 你已经着手准备的另一本书出版了吗？

sentences.en: Did you manage to make time in your diary for the media stuff you so enjoy?
sentences.zh: 你有没有在日程表中为你所热爱的媒体工作腾出时间？

sentences.en: How's the pandemic situation?
sentences.zh: 疫情情况如何了？

sentences.en: Currently both of your team have COVID-19 and here's hoping that by the time you receive this email that things are feeling a bit less risky on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 目前你的团队成员都感染了新冠，希望当你收到这封邮件时，每天的生活能感觉没那么大的风险了。

sentences.en: This level of threat is hard to sustain and we weren't geared up for it as humans.
sentences.zh: 这种程度的威胁很难长期承受，我们人类并没有为此做好准备。

sentences.en: Currently your kids are both a week away from going back to school and you're already practicing the dance you will do on that first morning when you get home with empty hands.
sentences.zh: 现在的你，孩子们离返校还有一周，你已经开始练习那天早上送走孩子、两手空空回到家时要跳的庆祝舞蹈了。

sentences.en: It's not been an easy 18 months for anyone and you're absolutely doing it well enough.
sentences.zh: 这18个月对每个人来说都不容易，而你已经做得足够好了。

sentences.en: Keep doing what you do even on the days you feel like no one is watching or can't be bothered.
sentences.zh: 继续做你正在做的事吧，即使在那些你觉得没人关注或者不想动弹的日子里也是如此。

sentences.en: People are watching and like what you do and you have the messages from some of them to prove it, go forth and do great things, or just get really good at sitting
sentences.zh: 人们在关注你，也喜欢你所做的一切，你收到的那些信息就是证明。继续前进，去成就伟大的事业，或者干脆练就一身坐在

sentences.en: on the sofa playing homescapes and gardenscapes.
sentences.zh: 沙发上玩《家居设计改造王》和《梦幻花园》的本领。

sentences.en: So that brings me to the end of my chapter in the
sentences.zh: 那么，我在《临床心理学家合集》中的

sentences.en: Clinical Psychologist Collective.
sentences.zh: 章节就到此结束了。

sentences.en: What did you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: I would love to know your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你的想法。

sentences.en: Please, if you're watching on YouTube, please do drop me a like and a comment.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在YouTube上观看，请务必给我点个赞并留下评论。

sentences.en: Let me know whether it resonated with you, what it evoked, what it brought up for you.
sentences.zh: 让我知道它是否引起了你的共鸣，它唤起了什么，又带给了你怎样的思考。

sentences.en: And if you haven't already read the Clinical Psychologist Collective, you can go along to Amazon by clicking the link in
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有读过《临床心理学家合集》，你可以点击描述栏或节目笔记中的链接前往亚马逊，

sentences.en: the description or the show notes and you can grab your own copy.
sentences.zh: 购买属于你自己的那一本。

sentences.en: People have said it's really, really helpful for them in upping their game in reflective writing.
sentences.zh: 人们说这本书对他们提升反思性写作水平真的非常有帮助。

sentences.en: If you have already read the book, I would be so grateful if you would consider dropping me a review on Amazon or Goodreads.
sentences.zh: 如果你已经读过这本书，如果你能考虑在亚马逊或Goodreads上给我写条书评，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: If you are an aspiring psychologist and would like some more free advice, please do come along to my website www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位有抱负的心理学家，想要获得更多免费建议，请访问我的网站 www.aspiring-psychologist.co.uk

sentences.en: where you can download your free psychology success guide which also gets wonderful reviews.
sentences.zh: 在那里你可以下载免费的心理学成功指南，它也获得了极好的评价。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到用时间换金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt. That includes six months of WhatsApp
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。这包括六个月的WhatsApp

sentences.en: support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日

sentences.en: November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述栏中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
